name: ia2-workspace-home
js: (async () => { const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const h=document.querySelector('.navhome'); if(h) h.click(); await w(1200); })()

name: ia5-home-inflight
js: (async () => { const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const h=document.querySelector('.navhome'); if(h) h.click(); await w(1200); const c=document.querySelector('.hcol'); if(c) c.scrollTop=c.scrollHeight; await w(500); })()

name: ia6-home-chanpicker
js: (async () => { const w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const h=document.querySelector('.navhome'); if(h) h.click(); await w(1200); const chip=[...document.querySelectorAll('.hcomposer button, .hrow button')].find(b=>/^#\s/.test((b.textContent||'').trim())); if(chip) chip.click(); await w(600); })()
